result.title: From NP-Hardness to Exact Tractability Through Sample Abundance
result.comment: 170 pages, 6 figures. Includes full mathematical proofs and supplementary code and data
result.summary: Additional observations can make exact optimization tractable without changing the objective or feasible set. We establish this phenomenon for noisy parity fitting, a worst-case NP-hard problem, with uniformly sampled rank-one sign tensor entries, independent fair factor signs and independent errors. For fixed interaction order $k\ge3$, $n$ signs per block, logarithmic mean degree and known channel biases, $O(n/(\log n)^{1/(k-2)})$ further readings of the same source suffice with high probability for exact optimization in $O(n\log^2 n)$ worst-case work. The leading coefficient is sharp for weak recovery by depth-$O(\log\log n)$ local estimators with independent reading marks. A common signed-field law determines the gain over the generating source, the number of tied optima and the dimension needed for later reweightings. The geometry of the remaining coordinates determines the sharp radius of local verification for high-scoring assignments with high probability.

AI.brief_summary: 研究带噪 parity 拟合这一最坏情形 NP-hard 问题：在随机秩一张量采样下，证明额外读取同源样本可使精确优化变得可解，并给出所需额外读取量、O(n log²n) 最坏计算量、弱恢复的尖锐系数以及局部验证半径的几何刻画。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「增加观测换取可解性」的论证以及并列最优个数、局部验证半径的分析，可能类比 LVR 中多 latent 假设的歧义消解、证据追加与停止决策，属较远领域线索，需核查可迁移性。
